en.t: Chinese emperor Xiao Yan names Xiao Tong his heir designate
en.s: Xiao Tong (traditional Chinese: 蕭統; simplified Chinese: 萧统; pinyin: Xiāo Tǒng; Wade–Giles: Hsiao T'ung, c.October 501 – 7 May 531), courtesy name Deshi (德施), formally Zhaoming Taizi (昭明太子, literally "Accomplished and Understanding Crown Prince"), was a crown prince of the Chinese Liang dynasty, posthumously honored as Emperor Zhaoming (昭明皇帝). He was the oldest son and heir apparent of Emperor Wu of Liang, whom he predeceased.

zh.t: 梁武帝萧衍立萧统为太子
zh.s: 502年12月24日，梁武帝萧衍立长子萧统为皇太子，当时萧统年仅一岁。大臣此前曾请求册立萧统，萧衍起初以天下尚未平定为由拒绝，后来同意册立。

en.t: Pope John IV is elected, several months after his predecessor's death
en.s: Pope John IV (Latin: Ioannes IV; died 12 October 642) was the bishop of Rome from 24 December 640 to his death on 12 October 642. His election followed a four-month vacancy. He wrote to the clergy of Ireland and Scotland to tell them of the mistakes they were making with regard to the time of keeping Easter and condemned Monothelitism as heresy.

zh.s: 教宗若望四世于640年12月24日就任罗马主教。他是在前任教宗去世后，经过四个月出缺期当选的。此后，他曾致信爱尔兰和苏格兰教士，纠正他们对复活节日期的计算，并谴责一志论异端。

en.s: The first Qarmatian invasion of Egypt took place in 971, when the Qarmatians of Bahrayn unsuccessfully invaded Egypt, which had recently been conquered by the Fatimid Caliphate. Both the Qarmatians and the Fatimids were offshoots of the Isma'ili sect of Shi'a Islam, but belonged to different and rival branches. Following the takeover of Egypt under the general Jawhar in 969, the Fatimids began their expansion into the Levant.
en.n: Battle of Ayn Shams: The Fatimids under Jawhar defeat the Qarmatians at the gates of Cairo, putting an end to the First Qarmatian invasion of Egypt.

zh.t: 第一次卡尔马特入侵埃及
zh.s: 第一次卡尔马特入侵埃及发生于971年。巴林的卡尔马特派未能攻下刚被法蒂玛王朝征服的埃及。卡尔马特派和法蒂玛王朝都源自什叶派伊斯玛仪派，但分属相互竞争的不同支系。969年贾乌哈尔将军攻占埃及后，法蒂玛王朝开始向黎凡特扩张。
zh.n: 阿因沙姆斯战役：贾乌哈尔率领的法蒂玛军队在开罗城门外击败卡尔马特派，结束了第一次卡尔马特入侵埃及。

en.t: Zengi captures Edessa after a siege
en.s: Imad al-Din Zengi captured Edessa, capital of the crusader County of Edessa, on December 24 after a siege that began in November. The loss of the city became a major cause of the Second Crusade. Edessa is the present-day city of Şanlıurfa in southeastern Turkey.

zh.s: 1144年12月24日，伊马德丁·赞吉在围城后攻占埃德萨。该城是十字军国家埃德萨伯国的首府；失守成为第二次十字军东征的重要起因。埃德萨现为土耳其东南部的尚勒乌尔法。

en.s: The Battle of Ephesus took place on 24 December 1147 during the Second Crusade. The French Crusader army, led by Louis VII of France, successfully fended off an ambush by the Seljuks of Rum outside Ephesus.

zh.s: 第二次十字军东征期间，法国国王路易七世率领的十字军于1147年12月24日在以弗所城外击退鲁姆塞尔柱人发动的伏击。

en.t: Pope Boniface VIII is elected, replacing St. Celestine V, who had resigned
en.s: Pope Boniface VIII (Latin: Bonifacius PP. VIII, Italian: Bonifacio VIII; born Benedetto Caetani; c. 1230 – 11 October 1303) was head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 24 December 1294 until his death in 1303. The Caetani family was of baronial origin with connections to the papacy. He succeeded Pope Celestine V, who had abdicated from the papal throne.

zh.s: 教宗博义八世（拉丁语：Bonifacius PP. VIII；意大利语：Bonifacio VIII），本名贝内代托·卡埃塔尼（约1230年—1303年10月11日），自1294年12月24日起担任天主教会领袖和教宗国统治者，直至1303年去世。卡埃塔尼家族出身男爵阶层，与教廷关系密切。他接替了退位的教宗切莱斯廷五世。

en.s: The Battle of the Melstica was fought between the army of the Kingdom of Hungary and the Ottoman Empire in 1443.

zh.s: 1443年12月24日，匈牙利王国军队与奥斯曼帝国军队在梅尔斯蒂察交战。

en.t: Siege of the Castle of Saint George
en.s: The siege of the Castle of Saint George, also known as the siege of Cephalonia, occurred from 8 November until 24 December 1500, when following a series of Venetian disasters at the hands of the Turks, the Spanish-Venetian army under Captain Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba and Benedetto Pesaro succeeded in capturing the Ottoman stronghold of Cephalonia.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1500年11月8日至12月24日，西班牙与威尼斯联军在贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦和贝内代托·佩萨罗率领下，攻占了奥斯曼帝国在凯法利尼亚岛的要塞圣乔治城堡。此前，威尼斯军队接连败于土耳其人。

en.s: The second rebellion of the Alpujarras (Arabic: ثورة البشرات الثانية; 1568–1571), sometimes called the War of the Alpujarras or the Morisco Revolt, was triggered by Philip II of Spain's Pragmatic Sanction of 1567 and was the second Morisco revolt against the Castilian Crown in the mountainous Alpujarra region and on the Granada Altiplano region, northeast of the city of Granada.

zh.s: 1568年12月24日，西班牙格拉纳达地区的摩里斯科人发动第二次阿尔普哈拉斯起义，反抗卡斯蒂利亚王室。起义由腓力二世于1567年颁布的法令引发，持续至1571年3月。

en.s: The siege of Stralsund was an armed engagement during the Great Northern War. The Swedish Empire defended her Swedish Pomeranian port of Stralsund against a coalition of Denmark-Norway, the Electorate of Saxony and the Tsardom of Russia, which was joined by the Kingdom of Prussia during the siege. A first attempt to take Stralsund was made in 1711, when the allies closed in on the town.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 施特拉尔松德围城战（1711—1715年）
zh.s: 1715年7月12日至12月24日，反瑞典联军围攻施特拉尔松德，并迫使守军投降。瑞典国王查理十二世逃往瑞典。此前，瑞典帝国一直在大北方战争中守卫这座港口城镇。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Bhopal was fought on 24 December 1737 in Bhopal between the Maratha Empire and the combined army of Mughals and their allies (Rajputs of Amber).

zh.s: 1737年12月24日，马拉塔帝国与莫卧儿帝国及其盟友安贝尔的拉杰普特人联军，在博帕尔交战。

en.s: The 1754 Taunton by-election to the Parliament of Great Britain was held across thirteen days, from 10 to 24 December 1754 in Taunton, the county town of the southwestern English county of Somerset. It took place following the death of the incumbent Whig Member of Parliament, John Halliday. The by-election was contested by Robert Maxwell on behalf of the Whigs, and Sir John Pole, 5th Baronet for the Tories.

zh.s: 英国议会汤顿选区补选于1754年12月10日至24日举行，历时13天。此前，该选区的辉格党议员约翰·哈利迪去世。此次补选中，辉格党候选人罗伯特·麦克斯韦与托利党候选人、第五代波尔从男爵约翰·波尔参选。

en.s: The Battle of Taraori in 1759 was a military engagement between the Durrani Empire and Maratha Empire and the Mughals in the fields of Taraori, in which the Afghans were victorious.

zh.s: 1759年12月24日，杜兰尼帝国与马拉塔帝国、莫卧儿帝国的联军在塔拉奥里的田野交战，阿富汗军队获胜。

en.t: Kiritimati, also called Christmas Island, is discovered by James Cook
en.s: Kiritimati (Gilbertese pronunciation: [kiˈrɪsmæs]), also known as Christmas Island, is a Pacific Ocean atoll in the northern Line Islands. It is part of the Republic of Kiribati. The name is derived from the English word "Christmas" written in Gilbertese according to its phonology, in which the combination ti is pronounced /s/.

zh.t: 詹姆斯·库克发现基里蒂马蒂岛（又称圣诞岛）
zh.s: 基里蒂马蒂岛（吉尔伯特语发音：[kiˈrɪsmæs]）又称圣诞岛，是太平洋中北部莱恩群岛的一座环礁，属于基里巴斯共和国。其名称源自英语“Christmas”按吉尔伯特语音系拼写；该语言中“ti”组合发音为/s/。

en.s: The Croisière du Grand Hiver (French "Campaign of the Great Winter") was a naval campaign carried out by the French Navy during the War of the First Coalition. Ordered by the National Convention in the wake of the French navy's tactical defeat at the Glorious First of June, the campaign was intended to challenge the Royal Navy for command of the sea.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1794年12月24日，法国海军舰队启程执行“大寒冬”远航行动，奉命驶入大西洋，挑战英国海军的制海权并袭击英国商船。舰队因风暴受损严重，次年2月返回布雷斯特。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: A bomb in Paris fails to kill Napoleon Bonaparte
en.s: A bomb exploded on Rue Saint-Nicaise in Paris on December 24 as First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte was traveling to the opera. Bonaparte survived the assassination attempt. The attack became known as the Plot of the Rue Saint-Nicaise or the machine infernale plot.

zh.t: 拿破仑在圣尼凯兹街爆炸案中幸免于难
zh.s: 1800年12月24日，第一执政拿破仑·波拿巴乘车前往歌剧院途中，巴黎圣尼凯兹街发生炸弹爆炸。波拿巴在这次刺杀中幸存。此事后来被称为圣尼凯兹街阴谋，也称“地狱机器阴谋”。

en.s: The siege of Deeg (11–24 December 1804) was a siege of the main fort at Deeg, now in the Bharatpur district of Rajasthan, India, then within the Bharatpur Kingdom. Forces of the British East India Company, led by General Lake, captured the fort from its Marathan defenders. The siege started on 20 November, the bombardment on 13 December, and a breach made at Shahburz, a salient on the southwest side of the fort, on 23 December.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1804年12月11日至24日，英国东印度公司军队在拉克将军率领下围攻并攻占了迪格主堡；迪格如今属印度拉贾斯坦邦珀勒德布尔县，彼时属巴拉特普尔王国。围城始于11月20日，12月13日开始炮击；12月23日，英军在城堡西南侧突出部的沙赫布尔兹炮台处打开缺口。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The War of the Sixth Coalition (French: Guerre de la Sixième Coalition; December 1812 – May 1814), sometimes known in Germany as the Wars of Liberation (German: Befreiungskriege) saw a coalition of Austria, Prussia, Russia, Spain, the United Kingdom, Portugal, Sweden, Sardinia, and a number of German states defeat the First French Empire and force Napoleon into exile on Elba.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第六次反法同盟战争（1812年12月至1814年5月）也称解放战争。奥地利、普鲁士、俄罗斯、西班牙、英国、葡萄牙、瑞典、撒丁王国及若干德意志邦国组成的联盟击败了法兰西第一帝国，迫使拿破仑流亡厄尔巴岛。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The French invasion of Russia, also known as the Russian campaign, the Second Polish War, and in Russia as the Patriotic War of 1812, was initiated by Napoleon with the aim of forcing the Russian Empire to comply with the continental blockade of the United Kingdom. Widely studied, Napoleon's incursion into Russia remains a focal point in military history, recognized as among the most devastating military endeavors to ever unfold.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法国入侵俄罗斯又称俄罗斯战役、第二次波兰战争，在俄罗斯则称1812年卫国战争。拿破仑发动这场入侵，意在迫使俄罗斯帝国遵守针对英国的大陆封锁。拿破仑入侵俄罗斯至今仍是军事史研究的重要主题，被视为历史上破坏性最强的军事行动之一。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Battle of Lomas de Santa María
en.s: The Battle of Lomas de Santa María was a battle of the War of Mexican Independence that occurred from 23 to 24 December 1813 in the area around Lomas de Santa María, in the municipality of Valladolid (present day Morelia). The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1813年12月23日至24日，墨西哥独立战争期间，西班牙王室支持者与争取脱离西班牙帝国的墨西哥起义军在圣玛丽亚山及其周边交战。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Hamburg took place from December 1813 to May 1814, at the end of the wars of the War of the Sixth Coalition. The French garrison of Hamburg, commanded by Marshal Davout, resisted the coalition forces of Prussia, the Russian Empire, and Sweden for nearly six months.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 汉堡围城战于1813年12月24日开始，至1814年5月结束，是第六次反法同盟战争末期的一场战事。达武元帅指挥的法军守军抵挡普鲁士、俄罗斯帝国和瑞典联军近六个月。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Britain and the United States sign the Treaty of Ghent
en.s: British and American negotiators signed the Treaty of Ghent on December 24 in the city now in Belgium. The agreement set the terms for ending the War of 1812 and largely restored the two sides to their prewar territorial positions. Signing did not immediately stop the fighting: the treaty still needed ratification, and news crossed the Atlantic slowly. The Battle of New Orleans was fought before word of the agreement reached the United States. The treaty took effect after ratification in February 1815. Its signing marked a decisive diplomatic step toward ending the conflict between Britain and the United States.

zh.s: 1814年12月24日，英国和美国的谈判代表在今天的比利时根特签署《根特条约》。条约为结束1812年战争设定条件，并大体恢复战前双方的领土格局。签署并未让战事立即停止：条约仍需批准，消息横渡大西洋也需要时间。新奥尔良战役发生时，美国尚未收到条约签署的消息。条约于1815年2月获批准后生效。签署条约是英美结束冲突的重要外交进展。

en.t: The first performance of "Silent Night" takes place in the Nikolauskirche in Oberndorf, Austria
en.s: "Silent Night" (German: "Stille Nacht, heilige Nacht") is a popular Christmas carol, composed in 1818 by Franz Xaver Gruber to lyrics by Joseph Mohr in Oberndorf bei Salzburg, Austria. It was declared an intangible cultural heritage by UNESCO in 2011. The song was first recorded in 1905 and has remained a popular success, appearing in films and multiple successful recordings, as well as being quoted in other musical compositions.

zh.s: 1818年圣诞前夜，约瑟夫·莫尔把歌词交给弗朗茨·克萨韦尔·格鲁伯，请他为当晚弥撒创作旋律和吉他伴奏。歌曲《平安夜》当晚在奥地利帝国奥伯恩多夫村的尼古拉斯教堂首次演出。

en.s: The Battle of Luchana (Lutxana in Basque) occurred at Bilbao and its vicinities during the night of December 23, 1836 and went on until December 24, 1836. The Carlists were besieging Bilbao and controlled the water and land routes towards the city. The battle of Luchana took place in the district belonging to the parish of Deusto and the municipality of Erandio, on the banks of the Asúa River, which empties into the Nervión at the spot known as Luchana.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1836年12月23日夜至24日，卡洛斯派围攻毕尔巴鄂期间，双方在毕尔巴鄂及周边爆发卢查纳战役。卡洛斯派控制着通往该城的水陆路线。战斗发生在德乌斯托堂区及埃兰迪奥市镇一带，地点靠近阿苏阿河注入内维翁河处的卢查纳。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1860 New South Wales colonial election was held between 6 December and 24 December 1860. This election was for all of the 72 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 52 single-member constituencies, six 2-member constituencies and two 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.

zh.t: 1860年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举
zh.s: 1860年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举于12月6日至24日举行，改选立法议会全部72个席位。选区包括52个单席选区、6个双席选区和2个四席选区，均采用相对多数制。

en.s: Expedition after Forrest was a military movement of the Union Army during the American Civil War.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1863年12月24日，联邦军开始远征，试图截断福雷斯特撤往密西西比州的退路。联邦军每天行军约20英里，并与福雷斯特部队多次交战；福雷斯特最终渡过田纳西河脱身，远征于12月31日结束。

en.t: Six Confederate veterans of the American Civil War founded a social club they named the Ku Klux Klan, which later became a white supremacist group
en.s: The Ku Klux Klan (KKK; ), sometimes referred to as the Klan, is an American white supremacist and far-right hate group. Historians widely identify it as one of the earliest terrorist groups in the United States, citing its organized use of violence and intimidation to influence political and social conditions, particularly in the post-Civil War South.

zh.t: 六名前邦联军老兵创立三K党，后者发展为白人至上主义团体
zh.s: 三K党（KKK；又称Klan）是美国白人至上主义极右翼仇恨团体。历史学家普遍将其视为美国最早的恐怖组织之一，理由是它有组织地使用暴力和恐吓，影响政治和社会环境，尤其是在南北战争后的南方。

en.s: The Battle of Hallue was a battle of the Franco-Prussian War on 23 and 24 December 1870. The battle was fought between 40,000 French under General Louis Faidherbe and 22,500 Prussian troops under Edwin Freiherr von Manteuffel. The French lost heavily in the village lying in front of their position. However, the Prussians were unable to carry the entrenchments on the heights.

zh.s: 1870年12月23日至24日，法军与普军在普法战争期间爆发阿吕战役。路易·法德尔布将军率领的4万名法军对阵埃德温·冯·曼陀斐尔男爵指挥的2.25万名普军。法军在阵地前方的村庄损失惨重，但普军未能攻下高地上的防御工事。

en.t: The first opera performed at the Khedivial Opera House, Aida eventually premiered in Cairo on 24 December 1871
en.s: Aida (or Aïda, Italian: [aˈiːda]) is a tragic opera in four acts by Giuseppe Verdi to an Italian libretto by Antonio Ghislanzoni. Set in the Old Kingdom of Egypt, it was commissioned by Cairo's Khedivial Opera House and had its première there on 24 December 1871, in a performance conducted by Giovanni Bottesini. Today the work holds a central place in the operatic canon, receiving performances every year around the world.

zh.t: 《阿依达》在赫迪夫歌剧院首演
zh.s: 朱塞佩·威尔第创作的四幕悲剧歌剧《阿依达》由安东尼奥·吉斯兰佐尼作词，故事设定在古埃及。该剧受开罗赫迪夫歌剧院委托，于1871年12月24日在该院首演，由乔瓦尼·博泰西尼指挥。此后，《阿依达》成为歌剧经典，至今仍在世界各地上演。

en.t: Reginald Fessenden transmits the first radio broadcast; consisting of a poetry reading, a violin solo, and a speech
en.s: Reginald Aubrey Fessenden (October 6, 1866 – July 22, 1932) was a Canadian-American electrical engineer and inventor who received hundreds of patents in fields related to radio and sonar between 1891 and 1936 (seven of them after his death). Fessenden pioneered developments in radio technology, including the foundations of amplitude modulation (AM) radio. His achievements included the first transmission of speech by radio (1900), and the first two-way radiotelegraphic communication across the Atlantic Ocean (1906).

zh.t: 费森登进行圣诞前夜无线电广播
zh.s: 1906年12月24日圣诞前夜，工程师雷金纳德·费森登据称首次向普通听众播送无线电节目，内容包括诗歌朗诵、小提琴独奏和讲话。这一说法主要依据费森登于1932年的回忆；文章指出，目前没有独立证据证实他所述的两次广播。

en.s: The Hyacinth incident was a 1910 British military action against suspected gun runners based in Dubai, then one of the Trucial States and now one of the United Arab Emirates, which resulted in street fighting between the town's citizens and British soldiers and culminated in the shelling of Dubai by HMS Hyacinth using high explosive munitions.

zh.s: 1910年12月24日，英国军队在迪拜对涉嫌走私枪支的人采取军事行动，引发当地居民与英军的街头冲突。英国海军风信子号随后使用高爆弹炮击迪拜。

en.t: The Italian Hall disaster kills families of striking miners
en.s: A Christmas Eve party for striking copper miners and their families ended in disaster at Italian Hall in Calumet, Michigan. Someone shouted that there was a fire, triggering a rush toward the stairs from the crowded upstairs hall. Seventy-three people died, many of them children. The identity and motive of the person who raised the alarm remained unresolved, so claims of deliberate sabotage should not be stated as fact. The tragedy occurred during a bitter labor dispute in Michigan's Copper Country and remains part of the region's public memory. A memorial now marks the former hall site.

zh.t: 意大利厅惨案造成73人死亡
zh.s: 1913年圣诞前夜，密歇根州卡卢梅特的意大利厅为罢工铜矿工人及其家属举办的聚会酿成惨剧。有人喊“着火了”，拥挤的楼上大厅里的人随即涌向楼梯，73人死亡，其中许多是儿童。最初喊出“着火了”的人的身份和动机至今没有定论，因此不能把蓄意破坏的说法当作事实。惨案发生在密歇根铜矿区激烈的劳资纠纷期间，至今仍留在当地公共记忆中；原礼堂旧址现设有纪念标志。

en.t: World War I: British and German soldiers interrupted fighting to celebrate Christmas, beginning the Christmas truce
en.s: The Christmas truce was a series of widespread unofficial ceasefires mainly along the Western Front of the First World War around Christmas in 1914. The truce occurred five months after hostilities had begun. Lulls occurred in the fighting as armies ran out of men and munitions and commanders reconsidered their strategies following the stalemate of the Race to the Sea and the indecisive result of the First Battle of Ypres.

zh.t: 第一次世界大战圣诞休战
zh.s: 1914年12月24日至26日，第一次世界大战西线多处英德部队非正式停火。士兵在圣诞节期间暂停交战，有些地方还走进无人区与对方见面。

en.s: The 1916 Tie Cup final was the final match to decide the winner of the Tie Cup, the 17th edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by Argentine side Rosario Central and Uruguayan club Peñarol, In the match, played at Racing Stadium in Avellaneda, Peñarol beat Rosario Central 3–0 with three goals by José Piendibene, winning the first and only Tie Cup trophy in the history of the club.

zh.s: 1916年Tie Cup决赛是阿根廷和乌拉圭足协联合举办的第17届赛事的冠军决胜赛。阿根廷的罗萨里奥中央队对阵乌拉圭佩纳罗尔队。比赛在阿韦亚内达的竞赛体育场举行，佩纳罗尔以3比0击败罗萨里奥中央，何塞·皮恩迪贝内包办三球，帮助球队夺得队史唯一一座Tie Cup奖杯。

en.s: The Grey by-election of 1917 was a by-election held during the 18th New Zealand Parliament.

zh.s: 新西兰第18届议会期间，Grey选区于1917年12月24日举行补选。

en.s: In the immediate aftermath of World War I, the region of Međimurje was occupied by forces loyal to the National Council of the State of Slovenes, Croats and Serbs, one of the predecessor states to the Kingdom of Yugoslavia, in November and December 1918. Predominantly inhabited by Croats, this territory was a part of the Kingdom of Hungary until it was captured by Yugoslav forces.

zh.s: 1918年12月24日，斯洛文尼亚人、克罗地亚人和塞尔维亚人国家委员会派出约3000人的部队进入梅吉穆列地区。匈牙利驻军没有抵抗，当天该地区即被占领。

en.s: The 1918 Christmas crisis (German: Weihnachtskämpfe or Weihnachtsaufstand; lit. 'Christmas battles' or 'Christmas rebellion') was a brief battle between the socialist revolutionary Volksmarinedivision and regular German army units on 24 December 1918 during the German Revolution of 1918–19. It grew out of an attempt by the government to reduce the division's size and move it out of Berlin. The fighting, which took place at the Berlin Palace, cost 67 lives.

zh.s: 1918年12月24日，德国革命期间，社会主义革命派海军师与德国正规军在柏林宫交战，造成67人死亡。冲突起因是政府试图缩减海军师规模并将其调离柏林。

en.t: Assassination attempt on Argentine President Hipólito Yrigoyen
en.s: Juan Hipólito del Sagrado Corazón de Jesús Yrigoyen (12 July 1852 – 3 July 1933) was an Argentine politician of the Radical Civic Union who served as President of Argentina from 1916 to 1922 and again from 1928 until his overthrow in 1930. He was the first president elected democratically by means of the secret ballot and mandatory male suffrage established by the Sáenz Peña Law of 1912.

zh.t: 阿根廷总统伊波利托·伊里戈延遇刺未遂
zh.s: 胡安·伊波利托·德尔·萨格拉多·科拉松·德·赫苏斯·伊里戈延（1852年7月12日—1933年7月3日）是阿根廷激进公民联盟政治人物，曾于1916年至1922年、以及1928年至1930年被推翻前两度担任阿根廷总统。他是首位依据1912年《萨恩斯·培尼亚法》规定的秘密投票和男性强制投票制度、经民主选举产生的总统。

en.s: The Third Battle of Changsha (24 December 1941 – 15 January 1942; Chinese: 第三次長沙會戰) was the first major offensive in China by Imperial Japanese forces following the Japanese attack on the Western Allies and the attack on Pearl Harbor, and Japan's third of four attempts to capture the Chinese city of Changsha. It was conducted with the purpose of severing Chinese lines of communication with British Hong Kong, and seizing control of Changsha's food production.

zh.s: 第三次长沙会战于1941年12月24日至1942年1月15日进行，是日本袭击西方盟国及珍珠港后，日军在中国发动的首次大规模攻势，也是日军第四次尝试攻占长沙中的第三次。日军希望切断中国经由英属香港的交通线，并控制长沙的粮食产区。

en.t: Capture of Saint Pierre and Miquelon
en.s: The islands of Saint Pierre and Miquelon, a colony of France off the coast of Newfoundland, were taken over by Free French Naval Forces on 24 December 1941. At the time, the islands' authorities had sworn their allegiance to the Vichy French government.

zh.t: 自由法国军队接管圣皮埃尔和密克隆
zh.s: 1941年12月24日，自由法国海军部队接管了纽芬兰附近的法国殖民地圣皮埃尔和密克隆群岛。当时，当地行政机构已宣誓效忠维希法国政府。

en.t: World War II: Benghazi is conquered by the British Eighth Army
en.s: The Eighth Army was a field army of the British Army during the Second World War. It was formed as the Western Army on 10 September 1941, in Egypt, before being renamed the Army of the Nile and then the Eighth Army on 26 September. It was created to better control the growing Allied force based in Egypt and to direct its efforts to lift the siege of Tobruk via Operation Crusader.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：英军第八集团军攻占班加西
zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，英国陆军第八集团军是一支野战军。它于1941年9月10日在埃及以“西部军”之名组建，之后先改称“尼罗河军”，再于9月26日改称第八集团军。组建这支部队，是为了更好地指挥驻埃及、规模不断扩大的盟军，并通过“十字军行动”解除托布鲁克之围。

en.t: World War II: French monarchist, Fernand Bonnier de La Chapelle, assassinates Vichy French Admiral François Darlan in Algiers, Algeria
en.s: Fernand Bonnier de La Chapelle (French pronunciation: [fɛʁnɑ̃ bɔnje də la ʃapɛl]; 4 November 1922 – 26 December 1942) was an anti-Vichy member of the French Resistance during World War II. He assassinated Admiral of the Fleet François Darlan, a key political figure of Vichy France and the high commissioner of French North Africa and West Africa, on 24 December 1942 in Algiers.

zh.t: 费尔南·博尼耶·德·拉夏佩勒刺杀维希法国海军上将达尔朗
zh.s: 1942年12月24日，法国君主主义者、抵抗运动成员费尔南·博尼耶·德·拉夏佩勒在阿尔及尔刺杀了维希法国的重要政治人物、海军上将弗朗索瓦·达尔朗。达尔朗当时是法属北非和西非高级专员。

en.s: Jean Louis Xavier François Darlan (French: [ʒɑ̃ lwi ɡzavje fʁɑ̃swa daʁlɑ̃]; 7 August 1881 – 24 December 1942) was a French admiral and political figure. Born in Nérac, Darlan graduated from the École navale in 1902 and quickly advanced through the ranks following his service during World War I. He was promoted to rear admiral in 1929, vice admiral in 1932, and lieutenant admiral in 1937 before finally being made admiral and Chief of the Naval Staff in 1937.

zh.t: 弗朗索瓦·达尔朗遇刺身亡
zh.s: 让·路易·泽维尔·弗朗索瓦·达尔朗（法语：[ʒɑ̃ lwi ɡzavje fʁɑ̃swa daʁlɑ̃]；1881年8月7日—1942年12月24日）是法国海军上将和政治人物。他出生于内拉克，1902年毕业于海军学院，第一次世界大战服役后迅速晋升。1929年晋升海军少将，1932年晋升中将，1937年晋升海军上将并出任海军参谋长。

en.s: The Zhitomir–Berdichev offensive (Russian: Житомирско-Бердичевская операция; Ukrainian: Житомирсько-Бердичівська наступальна операція), known on the German side as the Defensive battle at Zhitomir and Berdichev (German: Abwehrschlacht bei Shitomir und Berditschew), was part of the strategic offensive of the Red Army in the right-bank Ukraine, the Dnieper–Carpathian offensive. The successful offensive operation was conducted by the forces of the 1st Ukrainian Front commanded by General of Army Nikolai Vatutin during World War II, from 24 December 1943 through to 14 January 1944.

zh.t: 日托米尔—别尔季切夫攻势
zh.s: 日托米尔—别尔季切夫攻势是苏军右岸乌克兰战略进攻的一部分，由尼古拉·瓦图京大将指挥的乌克兰第一方面军于1943年12月24日至1944年1月14日实施。德军称之为日托米尔和别尔季切夫防御战。

en.t: Roosevelt publicly names Eisenhower to lead the Allied invasion of France
en.s: In a Christmas Eve radio address on December 24, 1943, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt publicly announced that General Dwight D. Eisenhower had been chosen to lead the coming Allied attack in Western Europe. Roosevelt spoke from Hyde Park, New York. The decision to give Eisenhower command had been made earlier; this entry records its public announcement, months before the Normandy landings.
en.n: Public announcement on December 24, not the original command decision or the June 1944 invasion.

zh.t: 罗斯福公开宣布艾森豪威尔将指挥盟军进攻法国
zh.s: 1943年12月24日，美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福在圣诞夜广播讲话中，公开宣布德怀特·艾森豪威尔将指挥盟军下一阶段在西欧的进攻。罗斯福当时在纽约州海德公园发表讲话。任命决定此前已经作出；诺曼底登陆则要到数月后才开始。
zh.n: 当天是公开宣布人选，不是最初作出决定，也不是诺曼底登陆日。

en.t: Battle of Hellzapoppin Ridge and Hill 600A
en.s: The Battle of Hellzapoppin Ridge and Hill 600A consisted of a series of engagements fought in mid-December 1943 on Bougainville between forces of the United States Marine Corps and the Imperial Japanese Army. Although minor in terms of casualties and in comparison to other battles in the Bougainville campaign, the battle was the last significant action undertaken by the 3rd Marine Division on the island before they were replaced by United States Army soldiers from XIV Corps.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 海尔扎波平岭与600A高地战役
zh.s: 1943年12月24日上午，海尔扎波平岭上的日军已在夜间撤离，美军海军陆战队巡逻队随后发现阵地空了。美军在攻占阵地时有4人阵亡、8人受伤，后来只在阵地上找到1具日军遗体。

en.t: World War II: The Belgian Troopship Leopoldville was torpedoed and sank with the loss of 763 soldiers and 56 crew
en.s: SS Léopoldville was a 11,509 GRT passenger liner of the Compagnie Belge Maritime du Congo. She was converted for use as a troopship in the Second World War, and on 24 December 1944, while sailing between Southampton and Cherbourg, was torpedoed and sunk by the German submarine U-486. As a result, about 763 US soldiers and 15 officers of the ship's crew died.

zh.t: 二战期间，比利时运兵船“莱奥波德维尔”号遭鱼雷击沉，763名士兵和56名船员遇难
zh.s: “莱奥波德维尔”号（SS Léopoldville）是比利时海运刚果公司的一艘总吨位11,509吨的客轮。二战期间，该船改装为运兵船。1944年12月24日，它在南安普敦至瑟堡航线上遭德国U-486号潜艇鱼雷击沉，约763名美国士兵和15名船员死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Konitsa was a conflict of the Greek Civil War (1946-1949); between the Communist led Democratic Army of Greece and the Greek Army of the Kingdom of Greece. It was a failed initiative to capture the northwestern Greek town of Konitsa, in order to establish a capital for the Provisional Democratic Government; a rival authority to the recognized government in Athens.

en.t: Libya becomes independent. Idris I is proclaimed King of Libya
en.s: Libya, officially the State of Libya, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa. It borders the Mediterranean Sea to the north, Egypt to the east, Sudan to the southeast, Chad to the south, Niger to the southwest, Algeria to the west, and Tunisia to the northwest. With an area of almost 1.8 million km2 (700,000 sq mi), Libya is the fourth-largest country in Africa and the Arab world, and the 16th-largest in the world.

zh.t: 利比亚独立，伊德里斯一世被宣布为利比亚国王
zh.s: 利比亚（正式名称：利比亚国）位于北非马格里布地区。该国北临地中海，东接埃及，东南邻苏丹，南接乍得，西南邻尼日尔，西接阿尔及利亚，西北与突尼斯接壤。国土面积近180万平方公里，是非洲和阿拉伯世界第四大、全球第16大国家。

en.s: Idris (Arabic: إدريس, romanized: Idrīs, Muhammad Idris bin Muhammad al-Mahdi al-Sanusi; 13 March 1890 – 25 May 1983) was King of Libya from 24 December 1951 until his ousting in the 1969 Libyan revolution. He ruled over the United Kingdom of Libya from 1951 to 1963, after which the country became known as simply the Kingdom of Libya.

zh.t: 伊德里斯登基为利比亚国王
zh.s: 伊德里斯于1951年12月24日成为利比亚国王，直至1969年利比亚革命中被废黜。他统治联合王国利比亚至1963年，此后该国更名为利比亚王国。

en.t: First flight of Britain's Handley Page Victor strategic bomber
en.s: The Handley Page Victor is a British jet-powered strategic bomber developed and produced by Handley Page during the Cold War. It was the third and final 'V bomber' to be operated by the Royal Air Force (RAF), the other two being the Vickers Valiant and the Avro Vulcan. Entering service in 1958, the Victor was initially developed as part of the United Kingdom's airborne nuclear deterrent.

zh.t: 英国汉德利·佩奇“胜利者”战略轰炸机首飞
zh.s: 汉德利·佩奇“胜利者”是冷战时期汉德利·佩奇公司研制并生产的英国喷气式战略轰炸机。它是英国皇家空军装备的第三种、也是最后一种V型轰炸机，另外两种是维克斯“勇士”和阿夫罗“火神”。该机于1958年服役，最初作为英国空基核威慑力量的一部分研发。

en.s: The Christmas Eve Battle took place during the Mau Mau Uprising on 24 December 1953 between British, African and Mau Mau forces and resulted in the death of Earl Wavell, the only son of Archibald Wavell. It took place around 25 miles north of Nairobi. Wavell was leading a patrol of British troops and African police pursuing from Mau Mau who had beheaded a loyal Kikuyu tribesman in the Thaika area. They tracked down about 20 of the Mau Mau who opened fire, killing Wavell immediately. The battle went for ten hours. Wavell had lost an arm during World War II.

zh.s: 1953年12月24日，肯尼亚茅茅起义期间，英军、非洲部队与茅茅武装交战，阿奇博尔德·韦维尔的独子厄尔·韦维尔在战斗中丧生。战斗发生在内罗毕以北约25英里处。韦维尔率领英军和非洲警察追捕茅茅武装；此前，后者在蒂卡地区砍下了一名忠于政府的基库尤人的头颅。巡逻队追踪到约20名茅茅武装人员后，对方开火，韦维尔当即死亡。战斗持续了10小时。韦维尔曾在第二次世界大战中失去一条手臂。

en.s: The Tangiwai disaster was a railway accident that occurred at 10:21 p.m. on 24 December 1953, when a railway bridge over the Whangaehu River collapsed beneath an express passenger train at Tangiwai, North Island, New Zealand. The locomotive and the first six carriages derailed into the river, killing 151 people. The subsequent board of inquiry found that the accident was caused by the failure of the tephra dam holding back nearby Mount Ruapehu's Crater Lake, creating a rapid mudflow (lahar) in the Whangaehu River which destroyed one of the bridge piers at Tangiwai only minutes before the train reached the bridge.

zh.s: 1953年12月24日晚上10时21分，新西兰北岛汤吉瓦伊发生铁路事故：一列特快客运列车驶过旺加埃胡河时，河上的铁路桥突然坍塌。机车和前六节车厢坠入河中，造成151人死亡。调查委员会后来认定，事故起因是鲁阿佩胡山火山口湖的火山碎屑堤坝溃决，泥石流涌入旺加埃胡河，并在列车到桥前几分钟冲毁了桥墩。

en.t: A flood devastates California, killing 74 people across portions of the state
en.s: From December 16 to 25, 1955, devastating flooding struck portions of California. It was caused by heavy rainfall and a levee break on the Feather River, and directly resulted in the deaths of 74 people, leaving damages of an estimated $150 million (1955 USD), one of the costliest floods ever recorded in California. The floods are commonly known as the Yuba–Sutter floods as there was extensive damage in Yuba and Sutter counties.

zh.s: 1955年12月16日至25日，加利福尼亚州部分地区遭遇严重洪灾。强降雨和费瑟河堤坝决口引发洪水，造成74人死亡，损失估计达1.5亿美元（1955年币值）。这是当地有记录以来损失最惨重的洪灾之一，常称为尤巴—萨特洪灾，尤巴县和萨特县受灾严重。

en.s: The Brinks Hotel in Saigon, also known as the Brink Bachelor Officers Quarters (BOQ), was bombed by the Vietcong on the evening of 24 December 1964, during the Vietnam War. Two Vietcong operatives detonated a car bomb underneath the hotel, which housed United States Army officers. The explosion killed two Americans, an officer and an NCO, and injured approximately 60, including military personnel and Vietnamese civilians.

zh.s: 越南战争期间，越共于1964年12月24日晚在西贡布林克酒店（又称布林克军官宿舍）实施爆炸袭击。两名越共成员在酒店楼下引爆汽车炸弹。爆炸造成两名美国军人死亡，其中一人为军官，另一人为军士，并有约60人受伤，包括军人和越南平民。

en.t: 1966 Flying Tiger Line Canadair CL-44 crash
en.s: On December 24, 1966, a Flying Tiger Line Canadair CL-44 flying from Tachikawa Air Force Base in Japan to Da Nang Airport struck an obstacle, stalled, and crashed into Binh Thai village, killing all four crew members and 107 people on the ground. The flight was on a subcontract for the United States Air Force. This was the first fatal accident for the CL-44 and the deadliest as well.

Only members of Parliament and regional delegates were entitled to vote, most of these electors having been elected in the 1968 general election and in the 1970 regional elections. It was the 68th edition of the Australian Open and the fourth Grand Slam tournament of the year. The singles titles were won by Argentinian Guillermo Vilas and American Barbara Jordan.

zh.s: 1979年澳大利亚网球公开赛于1979年12月24日至1980年1月2日在澳大利亚维多利亚州墨尔本的库扬体育场举行，比赛场地为室外草地。这是该赛事第68届，也是当年的第四项大满贯赛事。阿根廷选手吉列尔莫·比拉斯和美国选手芭芭拉·乔丹分别获得男女单打冠军。

en.t: First Ariane 1 rocket launches from French Guiana
en.s: Ariane 1 made its first successful flight on December 24, 1979, from the European Space Agency’s spaceport at Kourou in French Guiana. The launch followed two earlier countdown attempts that were halted or postponed. It began Europe’s independent Ariane rocket programme.

zh.t: 阿丽亚娜1号火箭在法属圭亚那首次发射
zh.s: 1979年12月24日，阿丽亚娜1号火箭从欧洲航天局位于法属圭亚那库鲁的航天发射场升空，首次飞行取得成功。此前两次发射尝试因故中止或推迟。这次发射开启了欧洲独立的阿丽亚娜火箭计划。

en.s: CAAC Flight 2311 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Changsha Datuopu Airport, in Changsha, the capital of Hunan Province, China, to the former Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport. On 24 December 1982, it was flown by an Ilyushin Il-18B (registered in China as B-202). After landing at Baiyun Airport, a fire in the cabin produced toxic smoke whereupon the crew stopped the aircraft on the runway and evacuated the passengers.

zh.s: 1982年12月24日，中国民航2311号班机执行从长沙大托铺机场飞往原广州白云国际机场的定期国内航班，执飞机型为伊尔-18B，注册编号B-202。飞机在白云机场降落后，客舱起火并产生有毒烟雾，机组人员随即将飞机停在跑道上并疏散乘客。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 601 was a scheduled Soviet domestic passenger flight from Arkhangelsk to Leshukonskoye in the Russian SSR, operated by Aeroflot. The Antonov An-24RV that was involved crashed on 24 December 1983 during approach to Leshukonskoye. Forty-four people were killed; five survived the accident. Pilot error was cited as the cause of the accident.

zh.s: 1983年12月24日，苏联民航601号定期国内航班在飞往俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国列舒孔斯科耶机场进近时坠毁。涉事飞机为安-24RV型，共44人遇难，5人生还。事故原因被认定为飞行员操作失误。

en.s: The eighth legislative assembly election for Tamil Nadu was held on December 24, 1984. Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (ADMK) won the election and its leader, incumbent M. G. Ramachandran (MGR) was sworn in as Chief Minister, for the third time. zh.t: 1984年泰米尔纳德邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 泰米尔纳德邦第八届立法议会选举于1984年12月24日举行。安纳德拉维达进步联盟（ADMK）赢得选举，其领导人、时任首席部长马鲁图尔·戈帕拉·拉马钱德兰（MGR）第三次宣誓就任首席部长。选举结果通常被归因于英迪拉·甘地遇刺和MGR患病所引发的同情浪潮，以及拉吉夫·甘地的高人气。

en.s: The 1990 Surinamese coup d'état, usually referred to as the Telephone Coup (Dutch: De Telefooncoup), was a military coup in Suriname on 24 December 1990. The coup was carried out by the acting commander-in-chief of the Suriname National Army (SNL), Police Chief Ivan Graanoogst. As a result of the coup, President Ramsewak Shankar was dismissed from power, and parliament and government were disbanded.

en.s: Air France Flight 8969 (Operation Rock Climber) was an Air France Airbus A300 flight that was hijacked on 24 December 1994 at Houari Boumediene Airport, Algiers. The militants murdered three passengers and their intention was either to detonate the aircraft over the Eiffel Tower or the Tour Montparnasse in Paris. When the aircraft reached Marseille, the GIGN, a counterterrorism and hostage rescue unit of the French National Gendarmerie, stormed the plane and killed all four hijackers.

en.s: Indian Airlines Flight 814, commonly known as IC 814, was an Indian Airlines Airbus A300 that was hijacked on 24 December 1999 by five members of Harkat-ul-Mujahideen. en.t: Chad–Sudan relations: Chad declares a state of belligerence against Sudan following a December 18 attack on Adré, which left about 100 people dead
en.s: The populations of eastern Chad and western Sudan established social and religious ties long before either nation's independence, and these remained strong despite disputes between governments. In recent times, relations have been strained due to the conflict in Darfur and a civil war in Chad, which both governments accuse the other of supporting.

en.t: The Lord's Resistance Army, a Ugandan rebel group, begins a series of attacks against civilians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, massacring more than 400
en.s: The Lord's Resistance Army (LRA) is a Christian extremist and Acholi nationalist organization operating in Central and East Africa. Its origins were in the Ugandan insurgency (1986–1994) against Yoweri Museveni, during which Joseph Kony founded the LRA in 1987. The group relied heavily on the abduction of pre-teens to fill its ranks, utilizing child soldiers as both frontline combatants and forced porters.

zh.t: 上帝抵抗军开始袭击刚果民主共和国平民
zh.s: 上帝抵抗军（LRA）是一个在中非和东非活动的基督教极端主义、阿乔利民族主义组织。该组织起源于1986至1994年反对约韦里·穆塞韦尼的乌干达叛乱；约瑟夫·科尼于1987年在叛乱期间创建LRA。该组织大量绑架未成年人充实队伍，让儿童兵充当前线战斗人员和被迫承担运输任务的劳工。

en.s: On December 24, 2018, a helicopter carrying Martha Érika Alonso Hidalgo, the newly elected governor of the Mexican state of Puebla, and her husband, senator and former governor Rafael Moreno Valle Rosas, crashed on a hill in Coronango near the city of Puebla. All five people on board the helicopter were killed in the crash: Alonso, Moreno, the two pilots, Captain Roberto Coppe Obregón and Captain Marco Antonio Tavera Romero, and an assistant to the senator.

zh.t: 2018年普埃布拉直升机坠毁事故
zh.s: 2018年12月24日，一架载有墨西哥普埃布拉州新当选州长玛尔塔·埃丽卡·阿隆索·伊达尔戈及其丈夫、参议员兼前州长拉斐尔·莫雷诺·巴列·罗萨斯的直升机，在普埃布拉市附近的科罗南戈坠毁。机上5人全部遇难，包括两名机长罗伯托·科佩·奥夫雷贡和马尔科·安东尼奥·塔维拉·罗梅罗，以及一名参议员助理。

en.s: On December 24, 2019, militants from the Islamic State in the Greater Sahara attacked the Burkinabe government military base in Arbinda, Sahel Region, Burkina Faso along with the town of Arbinda itself. The attack was halted due to French and Burkinabe air intervention, although 35 civilians were killed in the jihadists' massacre. The Arbinda attack was the deadliest incident in the jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso in several years.

zh.s: 2019年12月24日，大撒哈拉伊斯兰国武装分子袭击了布基纳法索萨赫勒大区阿宾达镇的政府军事基地和镇区。法国和布基纳法索出动空中力量，袭击因此被制止；但武装分子屠杀了35名平民。这是布基纳法索近年来伤亡最严重的圣战组织叛乱事件。

en.s: The Mo So Massacre, also known as the Christmas Eve Massacre, was a mass killing of civilians that occurred on the afternoon of 24 December 2021, in Hpruso Township in Kayah State, Myanmar. During the massacre, Myanmar Army troops killed and burned over forty people. The following day, the Karenni Nationalities Defence Force (KNDF) found the victims burned in their vehicles.

zh.s: 2021年12月24日下午，缅甸克耶邦普卢索镇发生大规模平民屠杀，也称“圣诞前夜大屠杀”。缅甸军方士兵杀害并焚烧了40多名平民。次日，克伦尼民族保卫军（KNDF）发现遇难者的遗体被烧毁在车内。
